data.title: US Vice President JD Vance says war with Tehran won't be 'forever' | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: JD Vance said during a White House briefing that although the war with Iran is not a "forever war," an escalation in the absence of a diplomatic solution would serve long-term US security interests.
data.keywords: Iran,United States,White House,Israel Iran War,JD Vance,Operation Epic Fury
